explainer.title: MeshCore Ultrasonic Sensor — Sender + Receiver
explainer.body:
This kit is a pair of MeshCore devices that bridge a MaxBotix ultrasonic distance sensor to the internet over LoRa.

  • Sender — a Rook (nRF52840) that reads the ultrasonic sensor and transmits [SENSOR] dist=... batt=... LoRa DMs.
  • Receiver — a Heltec V3 (ESP32-S3) that receives, ACKs, and POSTs the reading to Bayou over WiFi.

Flash both devices below, then use the Console to set WiFi credentials on the receiver and pair the two devices.

sensorSender.title: Ultrasonic Sender
sensorSender.tooltip: Reads MaxBotix MB7388 over UART, transmits distance + battery over LoRa

sensorReceiver.title: Bayou Receiver
sensorReceiver.tooltip: Receives LoRa DMs and posts them to Bayou over WiFi

notice.uf2Manual:
How to flash this Rook
1. Double-tap the reset button — a NICENANO USB drive appears.
2. Click Download below and drag rook_sender.uf2 onto that drive.
3. The device reboots automatically when the copy finishes.

commands.set wifi_ssid: Set WiFi SSID {ssid} (receiver, reboot to apply)
commands.set wifi_password: Set WiFi password {pw} (receiver, reboot to apply)

files.name: rook_sender.uf2
files.title: rook_sender.uf2 (drag onto NICENANO drive in bootloader mode)

v3-ultrasonic.notes:
v3-ultrasonic build
* MaxBotix MB7388 on Serial1 (D0 = P0.08, "RX1")
* Transmits [SENSOR] dist=... batt=... to the paired receiver
* Pair by running `advert` on the receiver, then `target <receiver-name>` on the sender

files.name: heltec_v3_receiver.bin
files.title: App firmware only (keeps existing bootloader, safe for updates)

v3-ultrasonic.notes:
v3-ultrasonic build
* Receives LoRa DMs, posts to Bayou
* Bayou defaults baked in (bayou_public_key = mfupcqtx34ee, bayou_private_key = t3w7v5zpk8ya) — override with `set bayou_public_key ...` / `set bayou_private_key ...`
* Set WiFi with `set wifi_ssid ...` and `set wifi_password ...`, then `reboot`
